first_impression.reaction: Two short paragraphs and then Key Takeaways, so I didn't have to dig. The first line is a bit of a warm-up, but "We sell neither" made me think this one might be straight with me. I read the takeaways, the short answer, and skipped down to the FAQ.

journey.reaction: Good. Every other result I opened is a jeweller trying to sell me something. This is why I'd keep reading.

journey.quote: A lab-grown diamond is real diamond with essentially the same physical, chemical and optical properties as a mined one, while cubic zirconia and moissanite are not diamond at all.
journey.reaction: That's the thing I actually wanted to know, right in the first bullet. Exactly what I came for.

journey.quote: Since 1 October 2025, GIA describes colourless lab-grown diamonds as "Premium" or "Standard" rather than on the colour and clarity scales it uses for natural stones.
journey.reaction: Didn't know that. It's dated and specific, so I trust it's current. Worth a bookmark for this alone.

journey.section: Are lab-grown diamonds worth it? The short answer
journey.quote: GIA notes that lab-grown diamonds are offered at a reduced price point, and that demand has risen in recent years.
journey.reaction: Reduced by how much? Half? A fifth? Just give me a rough idea. This is the bit where I'd go back to Google.

journey.quote: Here is how they compare, without prices.
journey.reaction: The table is nice and scannable on my phone, but 'without prices' is exactly the column I wanted. Even a ballpark ratio would do.

journey.quote: These are US rules, as at October 2026, but they are the clearest naming benchmark the industry has.
journey.reaction: Like that it's dated 2026. This section is long though; on the train I'd skim past the FTC detail.

journey.section: Worth it if, think twice if
journey.quote: Lab grown diamond engagement rings and natural ones can look the same across a dinner table; the difference is in what you value.
journey.reaction: The two lists are the most useful bit after the takeaways. Easy to screenshot and send to my partner.

journey.section: From the ring to the destination
journey.quote: If you are picturing a proposal or wedding overseas, browse destination wedding locations by region to see what each place offers in the season you have in mind.
journey.reaction: Oh, it's a destination wedding site. Bit of a jump from diamonds, but it's at the end and it isn't a pop-up, so fine. Not my next question today.

journey.quote: Not by eye. Separating them needs screening equipment and advanced spectroscopic testing at a lab such as GIA.
journey.reaction: Short, direct FAQ answers. This is what I like.
